problem: An unscoped SYSTEM STOP MERGES issued before CREATE TABLE did not prevent background merges on newly-created TimeRanges targets. Expected 16,384 rows for 8*2048 inserts but observed 8192 (IDs 2048). The level-8 checkpoint failed closed before any misleading join timing.
fix: For each TimeSeries table, resolve .inner_id.timeranges.<uuid> immediately after CREATE and run SYSTEM STOP MERGES <table> before any INSERT. Keep exact physical rows=N*2048 and unique IDs=2048 as preflight. Fail closed if it does not hold.
limitations: Do not use any k8 or k16 measurements from this run; neither exists.
k1-k4 are source-pinned complete small-frozen cases but not a full validated 5-level curve.
Absolute times across independent tables/physical right-row counts are not paired; within-level A/B/B/A is.
No compiled native ANY patch or production effect.
